description:
Create a Realtime translation client secret with an associated translation session configuration.

Client secrets are short-lived tokens that can be passed to a client app,
such as a web frontend or mobile client, which grants access to the Realtime
Translation API without leaking your main API key. You can configure a custom
TTL for each client secret.

Returns the created client secret and the effective translation session object.
The client secret is a string that looks like `ek_1234`.

requestBody.description: Create a client secret with the given translation session configuration.

404.description: The requested model was not found or is unavailable to this caller.

500.description: The requested model's availability could not be determined.

RealtimeTranslationClientSecretCreateReq.description: Create a translation session and client secret for the Realtime API.

expires_after.description:
Configuration for the client secret expiration. Expiration refers to the time after which
a client secret will no longer be valid for creating sessions. The session itself may
continue after that time once started. A secret can be used to create multiple sessions
until it expires.

anchor.description: The anchor point for the client secret expiration, meaning that `seconds` will be added to the `created_at` time of the client secret to produce an expiration timestamp. Only `created_at` is currently supported.

seconds.description: The number of seconds from the anchor point to the expiration. Select a value between `10` and `7200` (2 hours). This default to 600 seconds (10 minutes) if not specified.

RealtimeTranslationSessionCreateRequest.description:
Realtime translation session configuration. Translation sessions stream source
audio in and translated audio plus transcript deltas out continuously.

audio.description: Configuration for translation input and output audio.

anyOf.description: Optional input noise reduction. Set to `null` to disable it.

Optional source-language transcription. When configured, the server emits
`session.input_transcript.delta` events. Translation itself still runs from
the input audio stream.

model.description: The transcription model to use for source transcript deltas.

language.description: Target language for translated output audio and transcript deltas.

model.description: The Realtime translation model used for this session.

RealtimeTranslationSessionCreateRequest.title: Realtime translation session configuration

RealtimeTranslationSession.description:
A Realtime translation session. Translation sessions continuously translate input
audio into the configured output language.

audio.description: Configuration for translation input and output audio.

anyOf.description:
Optional source-language transcription. When configured, the server emits
`session.input_transcript.delta` events. Translation itself still runs from
the input audio stream.

model.description: The transcription model used for source transcript deltas.

language.description: Target language for translated output audio and transcript deltas.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp for the session, in seconds since epoch.

id.description: Unique identifier for the session that looks like `sess_1234567890abcdef`.

model.description:
The Realtime translation model used for this session. This field is set at
session creation and cannot be changed with `session.update`.

type.description: The session type. Always `translation` for Realtime translation sessions.

RealtimeTranslationSession.title: Realtime translation session

RealtimeNoiseReductionStrength.description:
Input noise suppression strength. Higher values apply more suppression.
Defaults to 1 when noise reduction is first enabled. Omitting strength
from a session update preserves the current strength.

NoiseReductionType.description: Type of noise reduction. `near_field` is for close-talking microphones such as headphones, `far_field` is for far-field microphones such as laptop or conference room microphones.

error_type.description: An optional classification; clients must accept additional values.

anyOf.description: An opaque target for explicitly continuing this review, or null when unavailable.
